code:
"""ex08 多智能体消息传递的循环检测：签名去重 + 阈值熔断。"""
import zlib


def sig(a, b, content):
    """消息签名：用 zlib.crc32（确定性），禁止用 hash()。"""
    return "%s->%s:%d" % (a, b, zlib.crc32(content.encode("utf-8")))


MESSAGES = [
    ("writer", "researcher", "请补充第三章的数据"),
    ("researcher", "writer", "请先说明你需要哪些指标"),
    ("writer", "researcher", "请补充第三章的数据"),
    ("researcher", "writer", "请先说明你需要哪些指标"),
    ("writer", "researcher", "请补充第三章的数据"),
    ("researcher", "writer", "请先说明你需要哪些指标"),
]

MAX_REPEAT = 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    seen = {}
    tripped_at = None
    for i, (a, b, c) in enumerate(MESSAGES, start=1):
        s = sig(a, b, c)
        seen[s] = seen.get(s, 0) + 1
        print("msg%02d %s -> %s  repeat=%d" % (i, a, b, seen[s]))
        if seen[s] > MAX_REPEAT:
            tripped_at = i
            print("  [熔断] 签名 %s 重复 %d 次，判定为循环死锁，停止协作并升级给人"
                  % (s, seen[s]))
            break
    print("处理消息数 = %d / 总消息数 = %d" % (tripped_at, len(MESSAGES)))
    print("熔断触发 = %s" % (tripped_at is not None))
    print("熔断后剩余消息不再处理 = %s" % (tripped_at < len(MESSAGES)))
